💡 cad-skill | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enable users to easily design and generate custom 3D-printable parts through natural language interaction with an AI assistant, powered by CadQuery for parametric modeling.
✨ Key Features: • Parametric 3D model generation using CadQuery • Integration with Claude Code for natural language interaction • Automatic script generation based on user descriptions • STL export and rendered previews • Iterative design process with AI assistance
📖 Summary: This repository provides a Claude Code skill that leverages CadQuery to generate parametric 3D-printable models. Users can describe a desired object, and the skill will automatically write the CadQuery script, export an STL file, and provide previews, allowing for iterative refinement.
